description: Main navigation with groups and supporting content.

howToUse: Use it for the main navigation of a site or a simple app, at the top: Product, Docs, Pricing.
Pass the `items` and mark the page open with `activeId`. Group related pages under one item with a panel.
alternatives: An app with many areas: Sidebar.

keyboard.action: Moves from one item to the next.
Opens the page, or the panel of a group. On a group, `Space` also works.

examples.label: Interactive
